items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: I went to jazz camp with Terrace in high school... we kept in touch all through the years... Terrace called me... I want you to play on some joints.

ctx.x: Now tell us about your collaboration with Kendrick Lamar on “To Pimp a Butterfly.”

Yeah, Kendrick, first of all a lot of my friends are on that, are producers on that, on all the Kendrick stuff from “Section.80” and “good kid, m.A.A.d. city” and all his records. One in particular, Terrace Martin, a producer, I went to jazz camp with Terrace in high school, when I was 15 years old, and we met each other then. He’s in L.A. He’s from L.A. and we all met at Loyola in New Orleans, they had like a national high school jazz band thing. We were both in there. So we kept in touch all through the years.…
